bos.meaning: Required: candle closes above the last swing high (86,994.3) - a break of structure

daily_trend.meaning: Daily trend up: yesterday's daily close above a rising 20-day EMA

ema_stack.meaning: Required: EMAs stacked up (8 above 21 above 55)

in_fvg.meaning: Price dipping into a recent fair value gap (counted against)

in_order_block.meaning: Price retesting the order block before the last BOS (counted against)

liquidity_sweep.meaning: Liquidity sweep in the last 10 candles: price dipped under a swing low and closed back above it

recent_bos.meaning: Break of structure in the last 20 candles (the tested settings count this AGAINST a buy)

reversal_candle.meaning: Bullish engulfing or hammer candle (counted against)

risk.meaning: Required: stop no more than 4.0% away

supertrend_green.meaning: Supertrend is green on this candle

trend_gate.meaning: Required: previous candle closed above the 50 EMA with Supertrend green
